result:
The seven P2 screens (Diagnose, Charter, Define, Design, Decisions, Gates, Evidence) are built in `apps/web/**` and wired to the live API, in Arabic RTL and English LTR. All required checks pass except the root `pnpm format:check`, which the sandbox blocks. Nothing is committed; the changes are in the working tree on base `27b3bd6`. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE-frontend-ux-engineer.md`.

**Check results**
- **Typecheck, build, lint:** `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build` and `pnpm lint` all exit 0.
- **Web unit tests:** 141 passed, including 30 new tests for the P2 screens.
- **Contrast:** `check:contrast` passes, 50 colour pairs meet WCAG AA.
- **e2e against the real stack:** 36 of 36 pass — 9 earlier journeys plus 9 new ones, each in English and Arabic. They ran on their own ports (database 54917, API 3917), so they don't collide with the concurrent backend agent. Axe found no violations of any severity on the 25 new pages per language.
- **Validator:** `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` passes.
- **Formatting:** Prettier on my files (`apps/web`) passes. The root `pnpm format:check` exits 2 because the sandbox can't read untracked files at the repo root (`.zshrc`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, …). It needs re-running in a normal checkout.

**What the e2e journeys actually exercise**
- Unquantified value pools are labelled, never 0, and the total reads "Partial: 1 unquantified".
- The good-outcome test shows pass, fail or unknown per criterion, with a translated reason for each.
- Saving a T02 row without a target date is refused before anything is sent.
- A real file upload works, including an Arabic file name.
- A gate decision on a submission that was replaced meanwhile gets the 409 message. The approval that follows moves the transformation to the Define phase. That approval is a synthetic demo approval by a dev user on a throwaway transformation.
- The read-only auditor has no enabled write controls on any of the 7 screens.

**Problems found and fixed along the way**
- Evidence uploads returned 503 because the default storage folder isn't writable. The e2e stack script now gives each run its own folder.
- The earlier audit-trail journey started failing because P2 writes new audit actions that showed as "action without a translation". I added 104 English/Arabic action labels.
- In Arabic, wide tables pushed the page wider than the screen; fixed in CSS.
- Links in hovered table rows failed colour contrast; they now use a colour pair the contrast check already covers.

**Behaviour changes you should know about**
- Governance, Strategy and KPIs, Target Operating Model, and Evidence and Reports are now "partial" areas. Each opens a list of transformations that leads into the matching workspace tab. I changed one step of the existing journey test accordingly. Any QA test that expects `/governance` to be a "planned" placeholder will need the same change.
- The Submit button for a gate stays disabled, with the reason shown, until every mandatory item is complete. That's because the server only allows submission once they are. So the "criteria incomplete" error is covered by unit tests only, not e2e.

**Not done**
- The team screen and the End-to-End/Modular guidance on the create screen. The work split assigns both to the frontend, but this assignment doesn't list them.
- Screens for workshop participants, dependencies and actions.
- Editing or withdrawing a decision option, and deciding on someone else's behalf.
- Editing methodology labels.
- In the audit trail, the names of changed fields on P2 records still show the "without a translation" marker; only the action names are translated.

**Contract issues for the architect / backend**
- The team list has no display names. Users without user-read permission therefore see owners as "Team member (role, ref.)".
- The reasons behind the good-outcome results, gate missing items and scope pre-checks come back as English text only. The UI translates from the codes and never shows that text.

**Screenshots** are in `apps/web/e2e/screenshots/{en,ar}/p2-*.png`. That folder is gitignored and I can't write to `docs/delivery/test-evidence/`, so they exist only locally and are regenerated by the e2e command in the handback.
